column1: # tools/timing/cases/level3_cases.tsv -- Level 3 measurement cases (hand-maintained).
# One row per case; a case is (app, case) and must be unique. Tab-separated, "-" = empty.
#   gpus       HPCPERF_GPUS for the run (one MPI rank per GPU through the common launcher)
#   env        NAME=VALUE;NAME=VALUE -- only variables the application's run.sh reads, plus
#              HPCPERF_SCALE_MODE (`tools/timing/cases.py allowed-env --level 3 <app>` lists them).
#              A variable set in your shell but not declared here is REFUSED: every run starts
#              from `env -i`. One variable may sweep, NAME=a|b|c, with {} in the case name.
#   args       extra arguments appended to run.sh
#   timeout_s  "-" = the application's default
#   fom_regex  "-" = the application's pattern
#   acceptance "validate.sh" when level3/<app>/validate.sh checks exactly this input numerically;
#              "-" when nothing does (the record then says verify_vs_roi = none and carries a caveat:
#              the run completed, its results were not checked against a reference)
# The timing cases are larger than the smoke inputs (those run the loop for 0.04-2 s on 2 GPUs):
# a main loop of tens of seconds to minutes on 2 x B200. Sizes and the recorded times they were
# chosen from: each application's README (RESULTS) and benchmark.yaml. Only the smoke inputs of
# CP2K (H2O-64), QMCPACK and DFT-FE have numerical acceptance; the strong / weak inputs of the other
# applications are completeness runs in their READMEs ("numerical acceptance of strong/weak runs"
# is an open item in CLAUDE.md).
#app
cp2k
column9: H2O-128 Born-Oppenheimer MD, 10 steps (GPW, DBCSR/DBM on the GPU); validate.sh checks H2O-64

column9: upstream's GPU regression deck (32-atom Al, 4 MD steps), VERBOSITY=1 for the per-SCF timer; smoke = strong for this deck
